capabilities: Syncs agent memories into the vault as Markdown notes with type, confidence and provenance frontmatter
Skips edited notes on later syncs and lists the files it skipped
Searches memories from a sidebar chat in recall mode, with date and change filters
Answers questions from stored memories in answer mode
Starts and manages a local Memanto server per vault
extras: Chat needs the local Memanto server on 127.0.0.1, so it is desktop-only; synced notes still open on mobile. Cloud backend has a free 100,000-operation tier; on-prem backend needs no key. API key is read from ~/.memanto/.env and never saved in the vault; only chat input is sent, never notes.
problem: What coding agents learn (decisions, preferences, facts, mistakes) stays outside Obsidian, with no way to browse, search or question it from the vault.
